why: A retracted article: Retracted Publication type plus a RetractionIn notice linked by PMID. Also a four-label structured abstract (CONCLUSION labelled, CONCLUSIONS categorised) with <i> runs, 23 MeSH headings with 17 qualifiers, an entity-encoded en dash in a keyword, & in the journal title, and no Issue element, so journalInfo carries no issue key (the journal invariant fails on an empty string, #213) while the Journal line and every citation read as before. The RetractionIn notice reaches the citations: Vancouver ends on its Retraction in: note, APA on its retraction parenthetical, and pubmed_format_citations' content[] warns before the first style (#215).
title: MicroRNA-582-3p negatively regulates cell proliferation and cell cycle progression in acute myeloid leukemia by targeting cyclin B2.
